crossRefs.note: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:
Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

translations.web: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
translations.bsb: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
translations.kjv: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
translations.asv: I cried unto him with my mouth, And he was extolled with my tongue.
